title: Stop Doing This When Parallel Parking
hook: Stop turning your wheels while parked.

script.narration: Stop turning your wheels while parked.

script.narration: Dry steering strains your steering rack and wears down your tread unevenly. Always roll forward slightly before cutting your wheel into a parking space.
